The scene ships: the asset path table lists ttl_z0007.ebp (7,168 bytes) and its motion file ttl_z0007.mot (81,920 bytes) as shipped (asset-paths.tsv, ids 1736 and 1737), and the game's archive holds both in all nine language folders (ch, cn, de, es, fr, in, it, kr and us). The 1,114 listings of the archive's us scripts hold 753 scene reads (eventread and eventread_e8); each names its scene by a literal id, and no read names 434. The one us script with no listing, evt_t0020.ebp (2,416 bytes, a bare script section without the EBP2 header the other scripts begin with), holds no 434 as a 16-bit or 32-bit little-endian value (the bytes B2 01) at any byte offset. The asset path table lists 1,037 us scripts (329 event scripts and 708 map scripts); the three it marks as not shipped, chb_z0000, msg_z0000 and men_z0004 (ids 1420, 1592 and 1760, ships 0), are in the archive in no language. The script that tests Phon Coast's location-title byte reads a different scene: in Kaukula Pass (Phon Coast), while global byte 0xCC2 (which the script names for Phon Coast's location title) is 0, the director reads scene 251 and plays it (fon_a06 lines 1130, 1135 and 1137; see fon_a0600's row).
